gemini-2.5-flash.notes: Excellent CRA alignment with correct Article 14 deadlines and wildExploited identification. Comprehensive coverage but slightly verbose at ~600 words.

gemini-3-flash.notes: Strong CRA compliance focus with clear deadlines. Well-structured with good actionability. Slightly better conciseness than 2.5-flash.

deepseek-v3.notes: Good CRA alignment but less detailed on Article 14 requirements. Most concise format but sacrifices some completeness. Some accuracy issues with CVE details.

analysis: Gemini-3-flash provides the best balance of CRA compliance detail, accuracy, and actionability while maintaining good conciseness. All models correctly identify the wildExploited CVE-2025-48384 and Article 14 obligations, but gemini-3-flash delivers the clearest compliance roadmap with specific deadlines and prioritized actions.
